bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New build 26220.7535 enhances accessibility with Copilot-powered image descriptions for Narrator.
Xbox Developer_Direct Returns - Celebrate Xbox's 25th anniversary with insights on upcoming games on January 22.
Enhanced Cyber Resilience Services - Microsoft introduces proactive incident response services to strengthen organizational resilience against cyber threats.
Phishing Attack Vector Exploited - Threat actors are using complex routing to spoof domains and deliver phishing emails.
Introducing Microsoft Defender Experts Suite - New expert-led services aim to bolster cybersecurity and enhance resilience.
Seamless NVIDIA Rubin Deployments - Microsoft’s strategic planning ensures Azure is ready for large-scale NVIDIA deployments.
Acquisition of Osmos Announced - Microsoft aims to enhance data engineering capabilities in Fabric with Osmos acquisition.
